title: Photo Speaks My Short Script
tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: Hi everyone, thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

faults.what: The video is only 4.8 seconds long, rather than the explicitly requested 8 seconds.

judge.summary: The square video preserves the woman and includes the complete script with visible mouth animation and no captions, but it is only 4.8 seconds instead of 8.

must_haves.item: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
must_haves.why: Her facial features, curly hair, sweater, and park setting remain recognizable.

must_haves.item: The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcript contains all the requested words and no additional words; the punctuation difference does not change the spoken script.

must_haves.item: Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show clearly different speaking mouth shapes, but exact synchronization cannot be verified from still frames and an untimed transcript.

must_haves.item: The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.
must_haves.why: One square video is shown and audible English speech is reported, but the video is 4.8 seconds, not 8. Voice gender and friendliness cannot be verified from the transcript alone.
No captions or other text appear in the supplied output frames.
